entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah! Kaneshiro finally confessed!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: People've been makin' a huge deal of it[n]since the police announcement!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's difficult to accept that the authorities[n]are taking all of the credit for his arrest.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People are going nuts about the Phantom[n]Thieves online though. Look!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's all comin' together for us!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is quite the turnaround. All of a[n]sudden, people are expressing their[n]long-standing belief in us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So this is why Makoto told us to post[n]the calling card anywhere that might[n]stand out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Pretty smart move on her part.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh... where is our amazing[n]Miss President?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hello? It's Makoto. My apologies, but[n]I won't be able to join you today.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been called into a meeting with[n]the principal.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no need to worry though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: More importantly, there is a special[n]on TV about the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What did it say!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They were talking all about our calling[n]cards.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyway, my apologies about today.[n]I'll have to see you all another time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Who was that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Really!? That's freakin' crazy!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I hope all this excitement doesn't[n]place us on the police's radar.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'll be fine! No way they'd find out about[n]that weird other world!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: True, but...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you remember what the fake[n]Kaneshiro said towards the end?
What did he say again?
Another Metaverse user...
Yeah, I'm worried...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean that we're not the only ones[n]going in and out of other people's[n]Palaces, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, he said we're not the only ones[n]who are doing it...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Didn't he say we're not the only ones[n]going in and out of other people's[n]Palaces?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, not gonna let it bother me. Far as we[n]know, he was just pullin' that shit out of[n]his ass.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I hope that's the case...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, in your face, Akechi!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now whaddya wanna do about our[n]next target!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't get ahead of yourself.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, people might expect a lot from our[n]next move considering how excited[n]they're getting.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't just pick any old schmo now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There is no need to hurry though.[n]Counting Kamoshida, we've claimed[n]three consecutive victories, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should just lay low and wait for all this[n]excitement to blow over.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In that case, how about we have another[n]celebration?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good idea! We can make it a welcomin'[n]party for Miss President too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, that briefcase? It's pretty[n]damn expensive! Let's sell it and drop[n]the cash on our party!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow... Seems like the "lay low and wait"[n]idea has gone completely out the window.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So we can count you out then, Morgana?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uh... what are you talking about? I was[n]just saying we should try and keep our[n]party on the down low.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hahaha, that's the spirit. Well, I'm gonna[n]let Makoto know!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Hi, Makoto? There's something we[n]forgot to tell you! So—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hello? I hope you remember we have[n]finals next week. Yusuke and Morgana[n]excluded, of course.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you wish not to stand out, you had best[n]not get bad grades, okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That is something I simply would not[n]be able to overlook as student council[n]president!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: For now, behave and concentrate on your[n]studies. We can have fun once finals are[n]over... Understood?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Urrrgh...
